name: Lifeguard, Swim Instructor and Front Desk jobs at Menlo Park swim centers (Menlo Swim and Sport)
org: Team Sheeper, Inc. (Menlo Swim and Sport), city pool operator
what_you_do: Work at Burgess Pool or Belle Haven Pool in Menlo Park, or Rinconada Pool in Palo Alto. Lifeguards watch swimmers and respond to emergencies. Swim instructors teach lessons to kids and adults.
who_can_apply: Lifeguard, Swim Instructor and Front Desk jobs say you must be at least 15. Lifeguards must pass a swim test (150 yards, 2 minutes treading with no hands, then 50 more). Swim instructors need a clean background check. Front Desk asks for 1 year of customer service work.
pay_detail: Lifeguard: $20 to $26 per hour. Swim Instructor: $23 to $28 per hour. Front Desk Associate: $20 to $26.25 per hour. Training is paid.
duration: Year-round and summer jobs. The swim instructor posting says shifts fit around school, sports and other jobs.
deadline_text: Postings are open with no closing date listed. The Swim Instructor job was posted Sep 30, 2026, Front Desk on Oct 14, 2026 and Lifeguard on Apr 24, 2026.
how_to_apply: Go to the Menlo Swim and Sport careers page and click through to the Team Sheeper job board. Pick a job and apply online. Questions: customerservice@menloswim.com or 650-781-5525.
notes: The city does not hire its own pool staff. The city's aquatics page says Menlo Swim and Sport runs both swim centers under contract, and its careers page links to the Team Sheeper, Inc. job board. You do not need to be a certified lifeguard to apply, they train you. The swim instructor posting says active employees get free lifeguard certification and calls the job good for high school students. Front Desk asks for experience, so it is harder for a first job.
